jobs.title: Sustainability Manager - 6 months contract
jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The partner-owned financial services group provides a comprehensive offering for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

We are seeking a Sustainability Manager, joining the Sustainability Team which supports the advancement of Pictet’s sustainability strategy across the private bank.
You will report directly to the Sustainability Lead and work day to day with PWM’s investment platform and sustainability colleagues across the Group.

Your role

• Support the delivery of PWM’s Sustainability Ambition 2030 by translating strategic priorities into concrete initiatives and business outcomes.
• Coordinate the development, enhancement and roll-out of responsible investing solutions across locations, in line with evolving regulatory requirements.
• Support the continued strengthening of PWM’s responsible investing framework, methodologies, policies and governance.
• Help shape and develop PWM’s impact investing mandate, including the underlying data, reporting capabilities and operational groundwork required to support this investment solution effectively.
• Lead and monitor key sustainability-related initiatives across products, ESG data, reporting, active ownership topics and tool/process improvements.
• Act as a key interface across the Investment Platform and with functions including Legal, Compliance, Risk, Technology, PAM and Group Sustainability.
• Support the promotion and positioning of PWM’s responsible investing offering to internal and external stakeholders.
• Act as a subject-matter expert on responsible investing topics, providing guidance, training and support to bankers, investment specialists and, where relevant, clients.
• Prepare high-quality internal and external materials, including management updates, presentations, training content, client materials and business development support.

Your profile

• Strong understanding of investments and financial services; wealth management and/or asset management experience preferred.
• Strong interest in sustainability and responsible investing; prior experience in sustainable finance, ESG or stewardship is an advantage.
• Good knowledge of ESG data, sustainability metrics, reporting and their practical use in investment processes and product management.
• Strong execution and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
• Hands-on, structured and solution-oriented, with the ability to move effectively between strategy and delivery.
• Excellent communication, writing and presentation skills in French and English; German and/or Spanish would be a plus.

Starting date : 1 February 2027

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

La tua squadra

Pictet Wealth Management combina oltre 200 anni di patrimonio bancario svizzero con competenze di investimento globali. Il gruppo di servizi finanziari di proprietà dei partner offre un'offerta completa per persone e famiglie ricche, tra cui soluzioni di investimento discrezionali e consultive e servizi di ufficio familiare.

Siamo alla ricerca di un responsabile della sostenibilità, unendo il Team Sostenibilità che supporta l’avanzamento della strategia di sostenibilità di Pictet in tutta la banca privata.
Ti riferirai direttamente al Sustainability Lead e lavorerai giorno per giorno con la piattaforma di investimento PWM e i colleghi di sostenibilità in tutto il Gruppo.

Il tuo ruolo

• Sostenere la consegna del PWM’s Sustainability Ambition 2030 traducendo le priorità strategiche in iniziative concrete e risultati aziendali.
• Coordinare lo sviluppo, la valorizzazione e la diffusione di soluzioni di investimento responsabili in tutte le sedi, in linea con i requisiti normativi in evoluzione.
• Sostenere il continuo rafforzamento del quadro di investimento responsabile di PWM, metodologie, politiche e governance.
• Aiuta a modellare e sviluppare il mandato di investimento di impatto di PWM, compresi i dati sottostanti, le capacità di reportistica e le basi operative necessarie per supportare efficacemente questa soluzione di investimento.
• Guida e monitora le principali iniziative legate alla sostenibilità nei prodotti, nei dati ESG, nei report, nei temi di proprietà attiva e nei miglioramenti dei tool/process.
• Agire come interfaccia chiave attraverso la piattaforma di investimento e con funzioni tra cui legale, conformità, rischio, tecnologia, PAM e sostenibilità di gruppo.
• Sostenere la promozione e il posizionamento dell’offerta di investimento responsabile di PWM agli stakeholder interni ed esterni.
• Agire come esperto soggetto-materia su argomenti di investimento responsabili, fornendo orientamento, formazione e supporto ai banchieri, specialisti di investimento e, se del caso, clienti.
• Prepara materiali interni ed esterni di alta qualità, inclusi aggiornamenti di gestione, presentazioni, contenuti di formazione, materiali client e supporto per lo sviluppo aziendale.

Il tuo profilo

• Forte comprensione degli investimenti e dei servizi finanziari; esperienza di gestione patrimoniale e/o gestione patrimoniale preferita.
• Forte interesse per la sostenibilità e gli investimenti responsabili; l'esperienza precedente nella finanza sostenibile, ESG o stewardship è un vantaggio.
• Buona conoscenza dei dati ESG, metriche di sostenibilità, reporting e il loro uso pratico nei processi di investimento e gestione dei prodotti.
• Forte capacità di esecuzione e gestione del progetto, con la capacità di gestire più priorità in modo indipendente.
• Hands-on, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione, con la capacità di muoversi efficacemente tra strategia e consegna.
• Ottima capacità di comunicazione, scrittura e presentazione in francese e inglese; tedesco e/o spagnolo sarebbe un plus.

Dein Team

Pictet Wealth Management verbindet mehr als 200 Jahre Schweizer Bankerbe mit globaler Investmentexpertise. Die partnerschaftlich geführte Finanzdienstleistungsgruppe bietet ein umfassendes Angebot für wohlhabende Einzelpersonen und Familien, einschließlich diskretionärer und beratender Anlagelösungen und Family Office-Services.

Wir suchen einen Nachhaltigkeitsmanager, der dem Nachhaltigkeitsteam beitritt, das die Weiterentwicklung der Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie von Pictet in der gesamten Privatbank unterstützt.
Sie berichten direkt an den Sustainability Lead und arbeiten Tag für Tag mit der Investmentplattform von PWM und den Nachhaltigkeitskollegen im gesamten Konzern zusammen.

Deine Rolle

• Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung der Nachhaltigkeitsziele 2030 von PWM durch die Umsetzung strategischer Prioritäten in konkrete Initiativen und Geschäftsergebnisse.
• Koordinieren Sie die Entwicklung, Verbesserung und Einführung verantwortungsvoller Anlagelösungen standortübergreifend im Einklang mit den sich ändernden regulatorischen Anforderungen.
• Unterstützung der weiteren Stärkung des Rahmens für verantwortungsvolles Investieren, der Methoden, der Politik und der Governance von PWM.
• Helfen Sie dabei, das Impact-Investment-Mandat von PWM zu gestalten und zu entwickeln, einschließlich der zugrunde liegenden Daten, Berichtsfunktionen und operativen Grundlagen, die erforderlich sind, um diese Anlagelösung effektiv zu unterstützen.
• Führen und überwachen Sie wichtige Nachhaltigkeitsinitiativen für Produkte, ESG-Daten, Reporting, aktive Eigentumsthemen und Tool- / Prozessverbesserungen.
• Handeln Sie als zentrale Schnittstelle über die Investmentplattform und mit Funktionen wie Legal, Compliance, Risk, Technology, PAM und Group Sustainability.
• Unterstützung der Förderung und Positionierung des PWM-Angebots für verantwortungsvolles Investieren für interne und externe Stakeholder.
• Handeln Sie als Fachexperte zu verantwortungsvollen Anlagethemen und bieten Sie Beratung, Schulung und Unterstützung für Banker, Anlagespezialisten und gegebenenfalls Kunden an.
• Bereiten Sie hochwertige interne und externe Materialien vor, einschließlich Management-Updates, Präsentationen, Schulungsinhalte, Kundenmaterialien und Unterstützung bei der Geschäftsentwicklung.

Dein Profil

• Starkes Verständnis von Investitionen und Finanzdienstleistungen; Wealth Management und / oder Asset Management Erfahrung bevorzugt.
• Starkes Interesse an Nachhaltigkeit und verantwortungsvollem Investieren; Vorkenntnisse in nachhaltigen Finanzen, ESG oder Stewardship sind von Vorteil.
• Gute Kenntnisse über ESG-Daten, Nachhaltigkeitskennzahlen, Reporting und deren praktische Anwendung in Anlageprozessen und Produktmanagement.
• Starke Ausführungs- und Projektmanagementfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten unabhängig voneinander zu verwalten.
• Hands-on, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv zwischen Strategie und Lieferung zu bewegen.
• Hervorragende Kommunikation, Schreiben und Präsentation Fähigkeiten in Französisch und Englisch; Deutsch und / oder Spanisch wäre ein Plus.

jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Tech designs, builds, and operates the technology that underpins the Group’s core activities, from portfolio management and trading to banking services. Within Data Platforms , our ambition is to build a modern, resilient, and scalable data foundation across the Group. We are transforming our technology landscape by combining cloud and on-premise strengths, modernizing how data is stored, processed, integrated, and distributed, and raising engineering standards across all domains.
As a member of the Analytics team, part of the Data Platform unit within the Platform Engineering department, you will help design, build and operate reliable data platforms and pipelines, turning complex challenges into secure, reliable, and high-performing data capabilities that power advanced analytics, AI solutions, and innovative audit use cases, and enable teams to deliver faster and with greater confidence.

Your role

• Design, build and maintain reliable data ingestion and transformation pipelines, ensuring they are production-ready, monitored and documented.

• Operate and improve the data platform in production, including orchestration, CI/CD, automation and infrastructure.

• Manage and evolve platform infrastructure across on-premise and cloud environments, ensuring security, stability, scalability and performance.

• Promote best practices in DevOps, release management, observability and infrastructure as code.

• Contribute to the platform roadmap by gathering user needs and helping prioritise capabilities based on business value.

Your profile

• Degree in engineering, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• At least 5 years of combined experience in data engineering and DevOps within a modern data platform environment.

• Strong programming and data querying skills.

• Experience in data ingestion, pipeline development and large-scale data transformation.

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD, automation and DevOps ways of working.

• Practical experience with cloud, containerised environments and infrastructure management.

• Familiarity with technologies such as Python, SQL, AWS, Kubernetes or Snowflake is an asset, but none is mandatory.

• Interest in a product-oriented approach to platforms, with a sense of user needs and priorities.

• Proactive, adaptable and solution-oriented, with strong communication skills and team spirit.

• Fluent in English and French.

• Swiss resident or willingness to relocate.

Your team

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment asset manager that is part of the Pictet Group, with a focus on private equity, private real estate, private credit and hedge funds.
PAA has invested in its data foundations: a shared data architecture, a canonical model of the business and a first catalogue of datasets. PAA is now looking to hire a Head of Data, accountable for making this data estate trustworthy and usable by investment teams, operations and the AI tools working on their behalf. Data ownership sits with the business, domain by domain; the Head of Data builds and runs the model that makes this work, and owns the platform the data lives on.
As Head of Data, you will report to the Chief Technology Officer and lead three teams: Data Solutions, which builds PAA's enterprise datasets and acquires data from external sources; Business Insights, which makes that data available to PAA teams for analytics; and Data Platform, which builds the foundations both run on. The technology function is small and hands-on, serving an organisation of about 160 people.

Your role

As part of the Technology team, your role will be:

• Setting the data governance model for PAA: naming owners for each data domain with the business, agreeing what each is accountable for, and running the forum where definitions and changes are decided.

• Leading the three teams as one data function, with one roadmap and clear interfaces between building datasets, serving analytics and running the platform.

• Representing data at senior level, explaining trade-offs, cost and risk to the Executive Committee and Pictet Group counterparts in plain terms.

• Agreeing data quality standards with the domain owners, measuring them, and fixing root causes when they are missed.

• Owning the data platform end to end, including architecture, pipelines, the canonical layer and the catalogue, and the decisions on what is built in-house, what is bought and which external data sources PAA acquires.

• Turning the data map into a working catalogue, where every dataset carries an owner, a freshness commitment, a sensitivity classification and an access route, kept up to date by the pipeline.

• Making PAA's data usable by AI, so that the data AI assistants and agents rely on is documented, governed and access-controlled, and investment teams can trust what those tools produce.

• Developing the people in those teams, including their product managers, and coordinating with Pictet Group engineering resources and external providers.

Your profile

• University degree in a quantitative or technical field, or qualification deemed equivalent.

• More than ten years' experience in data, including several years leading a data function or platform team.

• Direct experience with alternative investments data: funds and vehicles, commitments and cash flows, holdings and look-through, valuations and fees.

• Hands-on technical depth: able to read and write SQL and Python, review a data model and judge an engineering proposal; experience with a modern data stack (for example dbt, a cloud data warehouse, orchestration and testing).

• Proven ability to make shared data ownership work, getting business owners to take responsibility for their data without formal authority over them.

• Senior stakeholder management skills and the ability to explain technical choices clearly to non-technical colleagues.

• Pragmatic approach, favouring a standard the business adopts over a complete framework it does not.

• Ability to work in a regulated environment, in a multicultural team and with teams in multiple locations.

• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.
